semantics: DEC-0012 correctness-hotfix incident receipt. The frozen v1 product served wrong-subject images on 96 card faces; the hotfix nulls those exact bindings through the known-invalid-binding nullification path, projects them into the rejection guard, rebaselines quality to the exact corrected truth and returns the system to collection mode. It admits no public correction case and creates no public demand.

claim.summary: Ninety-six card images outside the audited Star Trek and Doctor Who scopes show a different subject, a different person, or a non-performance substitute, and were being served live.
claim.proposed_correction: Null each exact binding, reject each object by hash and locator, rebaseline quality to the corrected truth, leave replacement to exact-subject review.

evidence.value: UNDERCAST repository audit, 2026-10-22, section 4 (card media): two independent visual reviews of the 1,334 never-voted non-Star-Trek/Doctor-Who images found wrong subjects served live; the first confirmed 24 by opening bytes, the second counted 54 wrong and 43 probable; five sit on the default first page (UC-049, UC-067, UC-081, UC-099, UC-115).

Audit mapper a3e768a756817c6cf (verified by two adversarial verifiers): confirmed wrong by opening the files: UC-948 still (Transperth bus as Knuckles), UC-1047 still (Kepler-16 render as Luke Skywalker), UC-286 still, UC-603 still (real Roger Ailes), UC-722 still (Naruto Shippuden logo), UC-898 still (battleship Mikasa), UC-386 still (fan sketch), UC-470 portrait (user icon), UC-454 portrait (President Kennedy), UC-338 portrait (TARDIS); first-page stills UC-049 (fresco), UC-067 (Deadpool), UC-099 (gazelles), UC-115 (Migrant Mother), UC-081 (restaurant portrait); wrong-person portraits UC-232 and UC-258.

disposition.reason: The correction is prepared and gated on branch fix/media-wrong-subjects as a machine second-desk ruling on obvious wrong subjects. Operator ratification at pull-request review is the terminal disposition; on merge set status resolved, outcome accepted, decided_by the ratifying desk, and add the history-published event.
disposition.canonical_mutation_boundary: Applied only on the hotfix branch through scripts/estate-collect-known-media-corrections.mjs --ledger; the canonical W03 checkout and GitHub main are untouched until the operator pushes and merges.

return_to_collection_mode.statement: No product surface, reveal mechanic, schema concept or service layer changed. After merge the repository returns to DEC-0012 collection-only operations; the nulled sides re-enter the rolling media search as ordinary gaps and any replacement still requires exact-subject review.
